annotations.title: Get a working free data source, ready to run

description: Get a free data source that works right now, ready to run. Describe what you need in plain words ("daily EUR/USD rates", "US earthquakes this week", "known exploited CVEs") and get the best matching no-key endpoints Signal Lab has probed live: the exact URL, a curl line, a requests/pandas Python snippet, the auth requirement, the rate limit, the licence and commercial-use status as plain fields (from verified catalog data; "unknown" when not stated), when it last answered and with what HTTP status, the response's field names and types (plus a few sample rows when the licence is open), and healthy fallbacks if it fails. Saves the search, the dead links and the surprise sign-ups. Optional filters: no_key (default true), commercial_ok (only sources whose terms allow commercial use), category (catalog category or domain, see list_filters), limit. Signal Lab does not host the data: you fetch it from the provider.

category.description: A catalog category or domain, e.g. Macro or Cyber Threat

commercial_ok.description: Only sources whose licence data says commercial use is allowed

need.description: What data you need, in plain words, e.g. "daily EUR/USD exchange rates"

no_key.description: Only endpoints that need no key or sign-up (default true; every probed endpoint needs none)
